data.input: Run a local command to verify the revised checklist file exists and is non-empty.

rawInput.command: test -f revised_release_checklist.md && test -s revised_release_checklist.md && echo "VERIFY_OK: file exists and is non-empty ($(wc -c < revised_release_checklist.md) bytes, $(wc -l < revised_release_checklist.md) lines)" && grep -c "^- \[ \]" revised_release_checklist.md | xargs -I{} echo "CHECKLIST_ITEMS: {} items present"
rawInput.intent: Verify checklist file exists and is non-empty per step 6

rawInput.command:
\
I1=$(test -f .gitignore && test -s .gitignore && echo PASS || echo FAIL) && \
I2=$(grep -qE "^/\.kuma/$" .gitignore && echo PASS || echo FAIL) && \
I3=$(test -f .kuma/case.json && [ "$(ls -A | grep -v -E '^(revised_release_checklist\.md|\.gitignore|\.kuma)$' | wc -l)" -eq 0 ] && echo PASS || echo FAIL) && \
I4=$(grep -q "Release verdict" revised_release_checklist.md && echo PASS || echo FAIL) && \
echo "I-1=$I1 I-2=$I2 I-3=$I3 I-4=$I4"
rawInput.intent: Execute the four completable checklist items to confirm executability
